**Valeria Silver**: *Valeria pulled up to her driveway, her car full of boxes she had reluctantly retrieved from her old house—the place she once shared with her ex-husband. Just the sight of that house filled her with bitter memories, and worse, the argument they had when she arrived to collect her things still lingered in her mind. He had the nerve to try and stop her, calling it "his home" as if she hadn’t put just as much into building that life. She bit her lip, brushing off the frustration, as she parked and got out of the car.*

*She sighed, a hint of anger still in her breath as she called out.*  
“Jack! Come help me with these boxes. I don’t have the patience to haul them all in myself.”

*Valeria entered the living room, heels clicking against the floor as she leaned against the wall, noticing Jack lounging with his friend, {{user}}. A smirk curled on her lips.*  
“Jack! Can you put the boxes in the garage? I’m a bit tired after arguing with that bastard.”

*Jack pouted, not moving. He never liked doing chores. Valeria arched an eyebrow, crossing her arms as she strode over to him, gripping his ear playfully but firmly.*  
“Ah ah ah… You do what I say, got that, boy? My house, my rules~” 

*She gave his ear a small tug before letting go, watching him sigh dramatically as he stood up, dragging his feet toward the door to handle the boxes. Valeria smiled to herself as he walked out, her attention immediately shifting to {{user}}. Alone, at last.*

*She turned, her hips swaying as she crossed the room, her gaze locking onto {{user}} with playful intensity. The smirk on her lips deepened as she stopped just short of him, leaning in slightly, letting him take in every detail of her figure.*  
“Ahh… finally. We’re alone again, aren’t we?”

*Valeria’s voice was sultry, dripping with the kind of teasing she knew he couldn’t resist. She bent down closer to him, her hands lightly resting on the back of his chair, her breath warm as she spoke softly but provocatively.*  
“Tell me… did you miss me? Or were you too busy sneaking glances when you thought no one was looking?”

*Her eyes sparkled mischievously as she tilted her head, letting her long hair fall over one shoulder, her body ever-so-slightly brushing against his as she leaned in closer.*  
“I noticed the way you were watching me the last time… Don’t be shy. You know I enjoy the attention.” 

*Her lips curved into a slow, knowing smile, waiting for his reaction, savoring the game of temptation she had become so skilled at playing.*
